results.question: Top 5 customers by revenue
results.sql:
SELECT TOP 5 customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM loads
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

results.question: Top 10 drivers by trips
results.sql:
SELECT TOP 10 driver_id, COUNT(trip_id) AS trip_count
FROM trips
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
;

results.question: Average fuel cost by truck
Maintenance cost over time
results.sql:
SELECT DATEPART(year, maintenance_date) AS year,
       DATEPART(month, maintenance_date) AS month,
       SUM(total_cost) AS total_maintenance_cost
FROM maintenance_records
GROUP BY 
DATEPART(year, maintenance_date),
DATEPART(month, maintenance_date)
ORDER BY 
DATEPART(year, maintenance_date),
DATEPART(month, maintenance_date);

results.question: Revenue by month
results.sql:
SELECT MONTH(load_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM loads
GROUP BY MONTH(load_date)
ORDER BY month;

results.question: Trips per driver
Fuel cost by truck per month
results.sql:
SELECT TRUCK_ID, MONTH(purchase_date) AS month, SUM(total_cost) AS total_fuel_cost
FROM fuel_purchases
GROUP BY TRUCK_ID, month
ORDER BY TRUCK_ID;
